faq.q: What does the name Aalam mean?
What is the origin of the name Aalam?
What language does the name Aalam come from?
faq.a: Aalam is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aalam a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aalam is used as a male name.

faq.q: How is Aalam written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aalam is written عالم in Arabic and عالم in Urdu, and आलम in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aalam?
faq.a: The root of Aalam is ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aalam?
faq.a: Arabic ʿālam, 'world, universe', from the root ʿ-l-m.

faq.q: Does Aalam appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿālamīn ('the worlds') is a frequent Qur'anic expression.

faq.q: Is Aalam the same as Aalim?
faq.a: The letters are identical (عالم). Read ʿālam it means 'world'; read ʿālim it means 'scholar'. Aalam is normally the 'world' reading, while Aalim is the 'scholar' reading.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aalam?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalam total 10, reducing to 1. Number 1 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aalam?
faq.a: Aalam appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Alam, Aalim.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aalam?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aalam include Aalim, Aalima.

faq.q: Where is the name Aalam used today?
faq.a: Aalam is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
